title: Theory for groupoid equivariant neural networks: an approach for steerable CNNs on bounded domains
abstract: arXiv:2609.25987v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Equivariant convolutional neural networks are usually built from a group acting globally on the space of signals. This hypothesis is inappropriate for many bounded or stratified domains: an ambient rigid motion may be admissible only on part of the domain, and the boundary introduces geometric types that are invisible to a transitive group action. We develop a theory of groupoid-equivariant neural networks in which the symmetry datum consists of a groupoid, a selected pseudogroup of local bisections, a measure, and input and output representation bundles. For integral channels on the object space, we prove a bisection-equivariant kernel theorem: equivariance is equivalent to a transport constraint on the two-point kernel, and its solutions are classified by one joint-stabilizer intertwiner on each orbit of pairs. As a case study we apply the theory to bounded planar domains.   The resulting architecture is implemented through offline nul

translated_title: 群胚等变神经网络理论：有界域上可操纵卷积神经网络的一种方法
translated_abstract: 等变卷积神经网络通常由一个全局作用于信号空间的群来构建。这一假设对于许多有界域或分层域并不适用：环境的刚体运动可能只在域的一部分上是可容许的，而边界会引入在传递群作用下不可见的几何类型。我们发展了一种群胚等变神经网络理论，其中对称性数据由一个群胚、一个选定的局部双截断伪群、一个测度以及输入和输出表示丛组成。对于对象空间上的积分通道，我们证明了一个双截断等变核定理：等变性等价于二点核上的一个传输约束，其解由每一对点轨道上的一个联合稳定子交织算子来分类。作为案例研究，我们将该理论应用于有界平面域。所得架构通过离线……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种群胚等变神经网络理论，将有界域上的局部对称性形式化为群胚与局部双截断伪群，并证明了双截断等变核定理——等变性等价于二点核上的传输约束且其解由联合稳定子交织算子分类——从而为有界域上的可操纵CNN提供了数学基础。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a theory of groupoid-equivariant neural networks for bounded domains, proving a bisection-equivariant kernel theorem that equivariance amounts to a transport constraint on the two-point kernel with solutions classified by joint-stabilizer intertwiners, thereby providing a mathematical foundation for steerable CNNs on bounded domains.
